hero_title: Marriage curriculum couples will actually finish.
hero_body: Most couples in your church are not in crisis. They just keep having the same fights. Never Fight or Argue Again gives them a biblical plan for conflict that one spouse can start, even if the other is not ready yet. Fighting fair is not good enough. This shows couples another way.
what_body: Signed copies of the book for your couples, with the discussion guide in the back for group conversation, plus our free printable plans. Each couple also gets the 12-week interactive Companion Guide, where they type answers, save as they go, sign in across devices and download a filled-in PDF.
pricing_body: We do not list bulk prices on the site. Tell us about your church or group, how many couples you have in mind, and we will get back to you with details.
steps: Tell us about your church or group and how many couples you have in mind.
We get back to you with details for your group.
Your copies arrive signed and ready for your group.
leader_body: Every couple in your group can download the companion plans free, including the Anti-Fight Plan, the Safety Plan and the L.U.V. Framework. Print them for your group night.
form_intro: Tell us a little about your church or group and we will get back to you personally.
form_thanks: Thank you. We got your note and will be in touch soon.

faq.q: Can our church order tax exempt?
faq.a: Yes, many churches do. Tell us about your church in the form below and we will walk you through it.

faq.q: Can I get a sample copy before ordering for the group?
faq.a: Tell us about your church in the form below and we will help you with a sample. You can also read Chapter One free right now.

faq.q: Does this work for virtual or online groups?
faq.a: The book and the free printable plans work in any setting. The interactive Companion Guide works on a phone or a computer, so couples in a virtual group can use it the same way.

faq.q: Do leaders need training to lead it?
faq.a: No special training is required to begin. The discussion guide in the back of the book is a good place to start, and the interactive Companion Guide walks each couple through the weeks.

faq.q: What if only one spouse in a couple wants to come?
faq.a: That is who this book was written for. The plan is built so one spouse can start first.

meta_description: Signed copies in bulk and free leader resources for churches and small groups. A biblical conflict plan couples will actually use.
